name: Navn, etter fornavn (Statistisk sentralbyrå), table 10501
note: Every first name held by 200 or more people in Norway, with the count. Anne is held
by 55,625. The 200 floor is SSB protecting individuals rather than a sampling choice,
and it happens to sit exactly where this adapter's own threshold does.
CC BY 4.0, stated at https://www.ssb.no/en/diverse/lisens, explicitly including
Marked `authored` because there is no artifact and no integrity hash: SSB publishes
through PxWeb, which answers a POST rather than serving a file. So there is nothing to
pin. `decoy-fetch statistics-names` runs by hand and its output is committed beside the
query, which is re-runnable and diffable instead of hashed.
Queried as json-stat2 rather than CSV, and not for taste: the CSV form mangles `Ø` to
`Z2` and `Å` to `Z3`, which would silently corrupt every Norwegian name holding one.
The sex is encoded as the first character of each name's code -- `1EMMA` is female and
`2JAKOB` male -- and nothing in the response says so. Confirmed against known names
